paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under the 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations. The sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed, avg 0.03) begins at approximately 0.2 and declines steadily to near zero by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter. The sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted, avg 0.44) starts at 1.0 and decreases sharply, converging with the after-average-gate line near 0.15 by layer 10 before both stabilize. Notably, the after-average-gate configuration (green dash-dot, avg 0.33) consistently maintains higher sparsity than the after-gate line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with the two lines never intersecting after layer 5. The before-gate configuration demonstrates that pre-gating hidden states exhibit minimal sparsity throughout the network.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Тази фигура илюстрира сравнение на спряността (sparsity ratio) на изхода от SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) през различните слоеве на модел, при фиксиран праг от 1e-2, за три различни конфигурации на вратата (gate): преди врата, след врата и след средно врата. Оста X, означена като „Layer“, показва номера на слоя, с линейна скала, диапазон от 0 до 22 и етикети, разположени през интервали от 5. Оста Y, означена като „Sparsity Ratio“, показва стойностите на спряността, с линейна скала, диапазон от 0.0 до 1.0 и етикети през интервали от 0.2.

Първата линия, синя пунктирена („sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03“), започва при стойност около 0.2 в слой 0 и бързо намалява до около 0.05 в слой 5, след което остава почти постоянна на ниво близо до 0.0 до края на графиката. Втората линия, оранжева точкена („sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44“), започва при 1.0 в слой 0 и спада рязко до около 0.4 в слой 5, след което продължава по-бавно да намалява, достигайки около 0.15 в слой 10, а след това показва леки колебания около това ниво до края. Третата линия, зелена пунктирано-точкена („sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33“), започва също при 1.0 в слой 0, спада до около 0.8 в слой 5, след което продължава по-бавно да намалява, достигайки около 0.15 в слой 10, и след това остава сравнително стабилна с леки колебания, но винаги под нивото на оранжевата линия. Всички три линии показват спад на спряността с увеличаване на номера на слоя, но с различна скорост и крайно ниво.
model_annotations.Chinese: The chart displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across layers for three different gating configurations, under a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to approximately 22 with linear spacing and numerical ticks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear spacing and numerical ticks at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are plotted: the blue dashed line represents the sparsity ratio before gate (average 0.03), starting at approximately 0.2 at layer 0 and decreasing to near 0.0 by layer 5, remaining flat at near 0.0 for the remainder of the layers. The orange dotted line represents the sparsity ratio after gate (average 0.44), starting at 1.0 at layer 0 and decreasing sharply to approximately 0.45 by layer 5, then continuing to decline to around 0.15 by layer 10, after which it fluctuates between approximately 0.15 and 0.40. The green dash-dot line represents the sparsity ratio after average gate (average 0.33), starting at 1.0 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.35 by layer 5, then continuing to decline to around 0.10 by layer 10, after which it fluctuates between approximately 0.05 and 0.15. The green dash-dot line remains consistently below the orange dotted line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with no intersection occurring after layer 5.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across layers of a model, measured under a threshold of 1e-2, for three different gating configurations. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are shown: the blue dashed line (sparsity ratio before gate, average 0.03) starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0 and decreases steadily to near 0.0 by layer 5, remaining flat at near-zero values for the remainder of the layers. The orange dotted line (sparsity ratio after gate, average 0.44) begins at 1.0 at layer 0 and drops sharply, reaching approximately 0.4 by layer 5, then fluctuates between 0.15 and 0.4 for the rest of the layers. The green dash-dot line (sparsity ratio after average gate, average 0.33) starts at 1.0 at layer 0 and decreases more gradually than the orange line, reaching approximately 0.3 by layer 5, then continues to decline more slowly, stabilizing around 0.1 by layer 20. The green line remains consistently above the orange line for all layers beyond layer 5, with no intersection observed.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Sparsity-Ratio des SDPA-Ausgangs über die Schichten eines Netzwerks unter einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2, wobei drei verschiedene Gating-Konfigurationen verglichen werden. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Schichtnummer (Layer) und ist linear skaliert, mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis etwa 23, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Abständen von 5 angeordnet sind. Die y-Achse zeigt den Sparsity-Ratio und ist ebenfalls linear skaliert, mit einem Wertebereich von 0.0 bis 1.0, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Abständen von 0.2 angegeben sind. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie („sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03“) beginnt bei etwa 0.2 bei Layer 0 und fällt kontinuierlich ab, erreicht etwa 0.05 bei Layer 5 und bleibt danach nahe null, mit Werten unter 0.02 ab Layer 10 bis zum Ende der x-Achse. Die orange gepunktete Linie („sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44“) startet bei 1.0 bei Layer 0 und fällt steil ab, erreicht etwa 0.45 bei Layer 5, sinkt weiter auf etwa 0.25 bei Layer 10, stabilisiert sich dann um 0.15 bis Layer 15, zeigt danach leichte Schwankungen mit einem lokalen Maximum bei etwa 0.4 bei Layer 21 und endet bei etwa 0.35 bei Layer 23. Die grüne gestrichelte-punktierte Linie („sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33“) beginnt ebenfalls bei 1.0 bei Layer 0, fällt steil ab, erreicht etwa 0.35 bei Layer 5, sinkt weiter auf etwa 0.15 bei Layer 10, bleibt danach im Bereich zwischen 0.1 und 0.15 bis Layer 15, zeigt dann leichte Schwankungen mit einem lokalen Maximum bei etwa 0.13 bei Layer 21 und endet bei etwa 0.07 bei Layer 23. Die drei Linien verlaufen unabhängig voneinander ohne direkte Interaktion oder Überschneidung.
